name: Clamp
description: You clamp down on a target, attempting to deal damage and keep them in place. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to pry itself away with a {save}. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d6 {type} damage.
